content:
"Click the link provided to open a printable version of the puzzle.

addition to the standard Sudoku rules, each region outlined by grey lines must have its numbers add up to the total shown in the corner, and no digit may appear twice inside any of those regions.

All other rows, columns and 3×3 blocks still follow the usual requirement of containing the digits 1 through 9 exactly once.

If you want to check the finished grid, you will need to purchase the next edition of the Observer Digital Edition.

Enjoy solving the challenge and look forward to the solution in the upcoming issue."
